Lyell Halkias returns in a completely revamped mod,
packed with new and exciting content and lore to explore.
Join him on his journey of self-improvement and discovery.

Befriend Lyell to unlock the ability to date him, new cooking
and crafting recipes, quests, and animals.

Experience the return of old cutscenes
and the arrival of new ones as you
play through an immersive addition to Stardew Valley.
Go to the Articles tab to view his character wiki.

[b][i][u]Techincal Details:
[/u][/i][/b]Lyell will not appear unless you have triggered and watched his Introduction event.
Details on unlocking him are written below.

Go to the beach between the times of 5pm and 8pm.
It must be either Spring or Summer.
It can be either raining or sunny.
Can either be monday, tuesday, wednesday or thursday.
